name: Linen Yarn Curtain Transparent Window Screen (Cream White, Double Pack 52x108)
texture: linen-look slub weave, visible irregular yarns in close-up; semi-sheer
notes: Recommended vid 1728007103127756800 (Cream White, Double Pack 52x108 in = 132x274 cm, $9.15). Other relevant shades: Linen (oatmeal-greige) 52x108 vid 1728007100552454144, 52x95 vid 1728007100447596544; Cream White 52x95 (132x241 cm) vid 1728007103022899200 ($8.33). Gray (cool grey, likely outside mist range), Natural (pinkish beige), Pure White and Sea Mist Green (reads mint/teal, H>140, not sage) are NOT recommended. Shipping to IL (vid 1728007103127756800): CJPacket Sensitive 22-27d $25.49 (chosen: cheapest with reasonable time); also CJPacket Liquid Line 9-23d $25.95, CJPacket To Door 11-18d $30.13, CJPacket Eub 12-50d $17.55, DHL 3-7d $170.12. Cream White 52x95: Sensitive 22-27d $23.96. listedNum 185. GAPS: (1) Length: neither size fits 250-260 - 52x95 = 241 cm (too short by ~9-19 cm) and 52x108 = 274 cm (needs ~15-20 cm hem or puddles); width 132 is inside 130-150. (2) Heading is FRONT tab-top (visible loops over the rod) in all lifestyle photos; the Bible allows wave, pinch pleat or back tabs only. (3) Description lists a generic crafts list (lace, embroidery, printing...) and 'Packing list: Curtain*1' while variant names say 'Double Pack' - must confirm 2 panels per order. (4) Material is polyester linen-look, not real linen; close-ups show convincing slub texture but should be confirmed in a sample. (5) Measured Cream White swatch ~#E2DED3 (H44 S21 L86), slightly below the warm-white L range in the product photo; Linen swatch ~#CCC3BA (H28 S16 L76) sits between mist grey and oatmeal. Light transmission stated 40-70% (semi-sunshade), overlapping the 30-60% requirement. Images are studio composites with a colour-swatch sidebar and some watermark-free mockups; inventory per variant not reported by the API.
